Summary:
- SMB consumer/social gaming app focused on lightweight multiplayer lobbies and rich chat features.
- Primary need: real-time chat generation + robust abuse/spam controls. Low per-message token sizes but high concurrency spikes.
- Strong preference for hosted API (no infra ops). Public cloud OK.

Technical requirements / targets (from call):
- Peak concurrent chatters: initially ~3k-6k, planning for growth.
- Latency SLO: p50 < 80ms server-to-server, p99 < 200ms end-to-end for message generation. "can't tolerate more than 200ms p99" quoted from CTO.
- Throughput: short messages (~20-60 tokens) but frequent; want batching where it doesn't add headroom latency.
- Moderation: need integrated or very easy to wire-in content-moderation pipeline. Concern about false positives: "moderation that doesn't block legit talk". Must support rapid tuning.
- Abuse patterns: spam bursts, adversarial prompting, link spamming. Want near-real-time spam detection + per-user ratelimiting hooks.
